blocks.text: Cracking aik kimiyai amal hai jis mein bare hydrocarbon molecules (aam taur par naphtha ya bhari tel se) hararat se chhote, zyada mufeed molecules jaise alkenes mein toote hain. Yeh is liye zaruri hai ke ethene aur propene, jo chhote molecules hain, plastics aur masnoi rubber ka bara kacha maal hain. Do bare tareeqe thermal cracking aur catalytic cracking hain.

Thermal cracking carbon-carbon bonds torne ke liye bohat zyada darja hararat (aam taur par 450-750 C) aur zyada dabao use karti hai. Koi catalyst nahi hota, is liye amal ko zyada tawanai chahiye. Yeh aam taur par alkenes ki zyada miqdar deti hai, jo plastics ki sanat ke liye ahem hai. Maslan decane octane aur ethene mein crack ho sakta hai: C10H22 -> C8H18 + C2H4.

Catalytic cracking zyada kaarguzar hai aur jadeed refineries mein zyada use hoti hai. Catalyst, aam taur par zeolites (aluminosilicates) ya silica-alumina, activation energy ko bohat kam kar deta hai, is liye amal kam darja hararat (taqreeban 500 C) aur dabao par hota hai, tawanai bachti aur products par behtar control milta hai. Maslan bhari fraction naphtha catalyst par crack ho kar chhoti chain wale alkenes jaise ethene (C2H4) aur propene (C3H6) ka amezah deta hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar: carbon dhanchon ki shakal mein thermal cracking; das carbon ki zigzag chain (decane, C10H22) surkh dashed lakeer se kat'ti aur garam karne par aath carbon ki chain (octane, C8H18) aur double bond (ethene, C2H4) deti; halaat 450-750 C, zyada dabao, catalyst nahi. Neeche: catalytic cracking: naphtha catalyst par ethene (C2H4) aur propene (C3H6) deta; zeolites ya silica-alumina, taqreeban 500 C.
blocks.caption: Thermal aur catalytic cracking (topic 31.6.1 ka asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Cracking aik lambi chain ko chhote tukron mein torti hai. Kyunke har tukre ko saturated banane ke liye kafi hydrogen atoms nahi hote, kam az kam aik product ethene jaisa alkene hota hai.

blocks.text: Reforming aik refining ka amal hai jo hydrocarbons ki molecular banawat ko nai tarteeb deta hai. Cracking ke bar-aks, jahan molecules toote hain, reforming seedhi chain wale alkanes ko shakh-dar (branched) ya halqa-numa (aromatic) banawat mein badalta hai. Is ka bara maqsad kam octane wali seedhi chains ko zyada octane wale branched ya aromatic fuels mein badal kar fuel ka mayaar behtar karna hai, jis se engine knocking rukti hai.

items: Isomerisation (shakh-dar hydrocarbons banana): seedhi chain wale hydrocarbons zyada octane number wale branched isomers bante hain, maslan C6H14 -> iso-C6H14 (n-hexane se iso-hexane).
Cyclisation (halqa-numa hydrocarbons banana): seedhi chains halqe banati hain, maslan C6H14 -> C6H12 + H2 (hexane se cyclohexane).

Aromatisation (kitab ise dehydrocoupling kehti hai): hydrogen hata kar benzene, toluene aur xylene (BTX) jaise aromatic compounds bante hain, jo plastics, dyes aur masnoi reshon ki bunyaad hain. Hexane, chhe carbon ki seedhi chain, mustahkam aromatic halqa ban jata aur hydrogen qeemti zimni product (by-product) ke taur par nikalti hai: C6H14 -> C6H6 + 4H2 (Pt catalyst, hararat).

blocks.title: Hexane, cyclohexane nahi
blocks.text: Kitab equation C6H14 -> C6H6 + 4H2 par '(cyclohexane to benzene)' likhti hai. C6H14 hexane hai, aur equation hexane ke liye balanced hai. Cyclohexane se shuru karein to equation C6H12 -> C6H6 + 3H2 hogi. Hexane se yeh amal aam taur par dehydrocyclisation ya aromatisation kehlata hai.

blocks.alt: Teen qatarein. 1, isomerisation: chhe carbon ka zigzag (hexane) paanch carbon ki chain aur aik carbon ki shakh (2-methylpentane) deta, C6H14 -> C6H14. 2, cyclisation: hexane saada hexagon (cyclohexane) aur H2 deta, C6H14 -> C6H12 + H2. 3, Pt catalyst par aromatisation: hexane andar daire wala hexagon (benzene) aur 4H2 deta, C6H14 -> C6H6 + 4H2.
blocks.caption: Hexane ke reforming ke teen reactions (topic 31.6.1 ka asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Teenon aik hi seedhi chain se shuru hote hain. Isomerisation formula wahi rakhta lekin shakh banata; cyclisation halqa band karta aur H2 khota; aromatisation benzene ka halqa bhi banata aur H2 ke chaar molecules chhorta hai.

blocks.prompt: Jadeed refineries mein catalytic cracking zyada kyun use hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh zyada kaarguzar hai: catalyst activation energy kam karta hai, is liye yeh kam darja hararat (taqreeban 500 C) aur dabao par chalti, tawanai bachti aur products par behtar control milta hai.

blocks.prompt: Agar diesel ya kerosene se ethene aur propene jaise zyada alkenes chahiye hon to kaun sa cracking tareeqa behtar hai aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Thermal cracking, kyunke kitab ke mutabiq yeh aam taur par alkenes ki zyada miqdar deti hai.

blocks.prompt: Reforming mein hexane benzene aur hydrogen mein badalta hai. Hydrogen qeemti zimni product kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Hydrogen saaf fuel hai jis ki specific energy bohat zyada (taqreeban 120 MJ/kg) hai aur mufeed kacha maal hai, maslan ammonia banane ke liye.

items: Cracking: bare molecules se chhote aur alkenes.
Thermal: 450-750 C, catalyst nahi; catalytic: zeolites, taqreeban 500 C.
